MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing and electrical tape fit my breadboard, PCB, and relay purchases because they help insulate and organize connections when I assemble circuits.",
    "The capacitor assortment feels like a useful next choice because it gives me components to experiment with alongside my existing prototyping supplies."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The end mill and dovetail cutter require machining projects and equipment that my purchases do not indicate I use.",
    "The weld-on hook, T nuts, and T-slot bolts need specific mounting or fabrication projects; buying casters does not establish those needs.",
    "The 12–10 AWG wire taps serve heavier wiring than my small electronics projects suggest, even though they are electrical supplies."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on projects seems to have been stretched into an interest in specialized workshop tools of many kinds.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been taken as a broader need for furniture and mounting hardware, despite no matching project being evident."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of breadboards, PCB supplies, a relay, and a battery holder point toward small circuit assembly, where component compatibility matters.",
    "I would choose the assorted heat shrink kit for its sizes and colors; the adhesive-lined kit fits the same general task but adds a feature I do not currently need.",
    "I choose supplies when I can connect them to a concrete use, so a particular thread size, fixture type, or large quantity needs more justification than general usefulness."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small electronics work but stretched that interest too far into unrelated machining and mounting projects."
}
